long_biography.plain_text:
Converting a shareholder loan into equity made Dimitar Velikov Zhelev the controlling owner of Infra Expert, an established road-construction company. Its work covers road design, rehabilitation and maintenance, alongside water infrastructure, ports, airports and production of asphalt, concrete and road signs. The contractor also operates heavy machinery and supplies engineering services.

Infra Expert remains separately represented by its management team, with Zhelev's role centred on capital ownership. The company's integrated model combines new construction with repair, winter maintenance, materials production and technical services. This gives the business capacity to deliver road and civil-engineering work from design through ongoing upkeep.
